diagnostic_files.meaning: Exact original unified-diff blank context lines contain a required single context-marker space; original source bytes and hashes are preserved. No other file has whitespace diagnostics.

git_diff_check.limitation: The newly published files were untracked, so each was additionally checked with git diff --no-index --check against /dev/null.

scope: Publication source/copy and whitespace checks only; no control or campaign execution.
